entities.summary: Jean-Antoine-Joseph de Bry, also spelled Debry (French pronunciation: [ʒɑ̃n‿ɑ̃twan ʒozɛf dəbʁi];, was a French politician of the French Revolution. He served as President of the National Convention, and is famous for the slogan La patrie est en danger he proposed.
